data.body: Completion evidence: Gerrit change 1830 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1830) passed LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 with zero unresolved comments, then merged as d83ca19433a5fcde75302c12506df5d3e0201b6f; origin/main replication confirmed. Structural ACs: authorship.py is 454 LOC, authorship_resolution.py is 367 LOC, all five facade exports resolve, the explicit Any count remains exactly 2, and focused mypy is clean. Compatibility oracle passed 50 tests spanning resolver flags, held-out paths, identity, compaction, op-cert, and real-git bulk parity. TDD evidence: pre-implementation structural RED, one implementation attempt, held-out GREEN, plus a defect-seeded direct-subprocess mutation that made the withheld resolver oracle RED (resolver_calls 1 vs 2) and GREEN after restoration. Local gates: make lint PASS; make typecheck PASS (552 files); make test PASS (13,588 passed, 17 skipped); REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS=1 pytest -m not-integration/not-external PASS (13,588 passed, 17 skipped, 289 deselected, 20 warnings, exit 0, 3007.11s). No direct MCP/API resolver surface exists, so MCP/API parity is not applicable; the seam is read-only, so dual-direction mutation coverage is not applicable. No known residual implementation gaps.
